translations.web: So the nations will fear Yahweh’s name, all the kings of the earth your glory.
translations.bsb: So the nations will fear the name of the LORD, and all the kings of the earth will fear Your glory.
translations.kjv: So the heathen shall fear the name of the LORD, and all the kings of the earth thy glory.
translations.asv: So the nations shall fear the name of Jehovah, And all the kings of the earth thy glory.
